rites.name: Silameth
rites.text: Silameth is the concept of the Courts in Alainiel, the principle that a trial of worth is only meaningful when it is witnessed by a council that cannot be bought. During the Holy Age its doctrine shaped the temples and orders that kept the flame of the old oaths burning, and its scholars first drafted the rites for building the doors between worlds.

rites.name: Nalum
rites.text: A rhythmic self-slapping technique that a clever fellow proposes as the answer to a group's troubles. It is first pressed in a quarrel over repairs, and later saves a companion from a brute by distracting it.

rites.name: Telistia
rites.text: A fighting discipline recorded in a small ruled notebook kept by a master who teaches it at a school. Its moves can be performed fully by anyone who carries the matching page and wears a specific outfit.

rites.name: Ameostus
rites.text: Ameostus is the concept of the Sworn Pact in Alainiel, the oath that bound the broken worlds together after the Fall and the Sundering. It is remembered as the thread stitched through every Shard, holding what was scattered in place.
